items.title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Tapped For Potential Japan Business Deal Review
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) and Citi have been hired by Starbucks to assess a potential sale of Starbucks Japan. The possible transaction is described as a multi billion dollar deal linked to Starbucks' wider international business review. Starbucks is exploring options for its Japan unit as part of a broader look at its overseas operations and ownership structure. items.title: Banks Facing Bond Price-Fixing Trial Agree to Pay Over $400 Million
items.summary: Wall Street firms including some of the industry’s biggest banks are nearing an agreement to pay more than $400 million to end a high-stakes lawsuit claiming they schemed to fix prices in the muni bond market.
